literal_meaning: একবারে সব (এক প্রস্থ মাপের মতো পূর্ণ পরিমাণে)
figurative_meaning_en: all at once or in one go
example_sentences_in_bangla: একপ্রস্থ ঝগড়া করে বিষয়টা শেষ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: They ate everything all at once.
The argument ended in one go after a full-blown fight.
note: Refers to a full measure or extent, often used in rural or traditional Bengali contexts for actions done completely in one instance.
